answer: Attackers ride each gale of enrollment to mint fake identities outliving one-time fees. Fix: identity bonds with natural decay. Each identity locks a non-transferable 50-token bond decaying 5% per epoch; top-ups need fresh attestation, and newcomers wait a 3-epoch horizon to transact. Cost: N fakes for 10 epochs cost about N×25 tokens against decay, while an honest agent pays 50 tokens once, kept alive by attestations. A real agent roots like a juniper with one stake; fake fleets fade once upkeep exceeds reward.
